nodes.name: 曲率与曲率半径的积分表达
nodes.evidence: ①掌握用定积分表达和计算一些几何量（平面图形的面积、平面曲线的弧长、旋转体的体积及侧面积、平行截面面积为已知的立体体积、质心、形心等)及函数的平均值(仅数学一、数学二)

children.name: 形心坐标公式：横坐标=∫xf(x)dx/∫f(x)dx
children.evidence: $\frac{\iint_{D} x \mathrm{d} \sigma}{\iint_{D} \mathrm{d} \sigma} = \frac{\left| \int_{a}^{b} \mathrm{d} x \int_{0}^{f(x)} x \mathrm{d} y \right|}{\left| \int_{a}^{b} \mathrm{d} x \int_{0}^{f(x)} \mathrm{d} y \right|} = \frac{\left| \int_{a}^{b} x f(x) \mathrm{d} x \right|}{\left| \int_{a}^{b} f(x) \mathrm{d} x \right|}$

children.name: 形心坐标公式：纵坐标=½∫f²(x)dx/∫f(x)dx
children.evidence: $\frac{\iint\limits_{D} y \mathrm{d}\sigma}{\iint\limits_{D} \mathrm{d}\sigma} = \frac{\int_{a}^{b} \mathrm{d}x \int_{0}^{f(x)} y \mathrm{d}y}{\int_{a}^{b} \mathrm{d}x \int_{0}^{f(x)} \mathrm{d}y} = \frac{\left| \frac{1}{2} \int_{a}^{b} f^2(x) \mathrm{d}x \right|}{\int_{a}^{b} f(x) \mathrm{d}x}$

conclusions.statement: 直角坐标下两曲线及x=a,x=b围成平面图形面积 S=∫ₐᵇ|y₁(x)-y₂(x)|dx
conclusions.evidence: $S = \int _ { a } ^ { b } \left| y _ { 1 } ( x ) - y _ { 2 } ( x ) \right| \mathrm { d } x .$

conclusions.statement: 极坐标下曲边扇形面积 S=½∫ₐᵝ|r₁²(θ)-r₂²(θ)|dθ
平面曲线绕定直线Ax+By+C=0旋转所得旋转体体积公式(10-1)
conclusions.evidence: $\frac { \pi } { \left( A ^ { 2 } + B ^ { 2 } \right) ^ { \frac { 3 } { 2 } } } \int _ { a } ^ { b } \left[ A x + B f ( x ) + C \right] ^ { 2 } \left| A f ^ { \prime } ( x ) - B \right| \mathrm { d } x .$

conclusions.statement: 平面曲线弧长公式：直角坐标、参数方程、极坐标三种形式
conclusions.evidence: 若平面光滑曲线由极坐标方程 $r = r(\theta) (\alpha \leq \theta \leq \beta)$ 给出，则 $s = \int _ { \alpha } ^ { \beta } \sqrt { \left[ r ( \theta ) \right] ^ { 2 } + \left[ r ^ { \prime } ( \theta ) \right] ^ { 2 } } \mathrm { d } \theta$
$S = 2 \pi \int _ { a } ^ { b } \left| y \right| \sqrt { 1 + \left( y _ { x } ^ { \prime } \right) ^ { 2 } } \mathrm { d } x .$

conclusions.statement: 曲线绕x轴旋转体积特例：V=π∫ₐᵇf²(x)dx
conclusions.evidence: $V = \pi \int_{a}^{b} f^{2}(x) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{(B^{2})^{2}} \int_{a}^{b} \left| B f(x) \right|^{2} \left| - B \right| \mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{\left| B \right|^{3}} \int_{a}^{b} B^{2} \left| B \right| f^{2}(x) \mathrm{d}x = \pi \int_{a}^{b} f^{2}(x) \mathrm{d}x$
